turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Example: eats / Mia / rice / at noon becomes Mia eats rice at noon.
Rule: Write who first, then the action, then the thing, then place or time.
Right: Tom reads books at home. Wrong: Reads Tom books at home.
Now you try.
Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
